resultJson.title: Add Python manipulation chapter
resultJson.body:
Adds `python-manipulation.md`, a chapter on manipulating core Python data types, written for task "3, Write file Python manipulation chapter."

- Covers strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, files and JSON, each with runnable snippets.
- Includes a word-frequency example that combines several of them, a set of exercises, and a summary table.
- The text states the snippets target Python 3.9+. I did not run them.

The diff also adds the `.orca/runs/d47fbb146f2c.progress.json` run-progress file.
